label: Posts Room
literalRoomDescription: This is an enormous room, in the center of which are four wooden posts delineating a rectangular area, above which is what appears to be a wooden roof. In fact, all objects in this room appear to be abnormally large. To the east is a passageway. There are large gaping chasms to the west and northwest.
safeSceneProfile: Abnormally large-scale room with four wooden posts and roof-like structure; east passage and west/northwest chasms. Preserve relative scale puzzle without changing player physics or source routes.
